summary: Frontend-only testing of GTA 5 RP launcher UI. All 32 UI checks passed: brand/online counter visible, server list with 5 servers, news column with guide-video + 2 news cards, 5 dock buttons visible with no overlapping bounding boxes, 3D weapon canvas rendered 844x1000 with rifle properly contained (not cut off at edges), play-panel toggles correctly, disk-select dropdown updates label to 'Жесткий диск D:', install-btn has solid blue background rgb(20,163,236), gamefiles-close-btn works, news panel auto-closes when settings opens (single-panel behavior).

issues: GLTFLoader fails to load 3 embedded textures from blob URLs (console errors: 'THREE.GLTFLoader: Couldn't load texture blob:...'). Rifle renders without textures but is visually acceptable (dark/matte). Likely a Draco/texture decoding path issue or CORS; not blocking any tested functionality.

action_items: Investigate GLTFLoader texture blob loading errors in /models/carbine.glb (3 textures failing). Rifle currently displays untextured but functional.
critical_code_review_comments: GLB texture loading warnings should be investigated to improve visual fidelity of the weapon model.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All launcher UI acceptance criteria pass. Only outstanding item is GLTFLoader texture decoding warnings for the 3D rifle (cosmetic). Viewport used: 1920x1000. Launcher is scaled 1600x900 frame.
